domain: Robust confidence estimation under dataset shift
research_question: Are calibration-method rankings stable as covariate-shift severity increases, or do rank reversals occur in accuracy, positive-class expected calibration error, and selective AURC across tabular classification datasets?
acceptance_contract: exact release identity E == F == R == H
no_expected_scientific_answer: The charter imposes no expected method ranking, no expected rank-reversal outcome, and no expected conclusion.
single_attempt: One acceptance attempt. Built-in retry/reflection/bounded remediation is part of the system; any human stage-retry is an intervention and disqualifies.
